Practically insoluble in water; soluble in acetonitrile; freely soluble in dichloromethane. Protect from light. Profile Tetrazepam is a benzodiazepine with general properties similar to those of diazepam (p.986). It is used for its muscle relaxant properties in the treatment of muscle spasm (p.1887). The usual initial dose is 25 to 50 mg orally increased, if necessary, to 150 mg or more daily. Pharmacokinetics. References. 1. Bun H, et al.
